#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <utility>

int getWonMaxFast(std::array<int,3>& a, std::array<int,3>& b) {
    std::array<int,3> wins = {0,0,0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        int good = (i + 1) % 3;
        int add = std::min(a[i], b[good]);
        wins[i] = add;
        a[i] -= add;
        b[good] -= add;
    }
    return wins[0] + wins[1] + wins[2];
}

int getLostMaxFast(const std::array<int,3>& a, const std::array<int,3>& b) {
    std::vector<std::pair<int,int>> ways = {
        {0,2}, {1,0}, {2,1}, {0,0}, {1,1}, {2,2}
    };
    std::sort(ways.begin(), ways.end());
    int maxLost = 0;
    do {
        std::array<int,3> localA = a;
        std::array<int,3> localB = b;
        int lostSum = 0;
        for (const auto& p : ways) {
            int add = std::min(localA[p.first], localB[p.second]);
            localA[p.first] -= add;
            localB[p.second] -= add;
            lostSum += add;
        }
        if (lostSum > maxLost) maxLost = lostSum;
    } while (std::next_permutation(ways.begin(), ways.end()));
    return maxLost;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::array<int,3> inputA, inputB;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) std::cin >> inputA[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) std::cin >> inputB[i];

    std::array<int,3> inputA2 = inputA;
    std::array<int,3> inputB2 = inputB;

    int lostMax = getLostMaxFast(inputA2, inputB2);
    int wonMax = getWonMaxFast(inputA, inputB);

    std::cout << n - lostMax << " " << wonMax << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
